title: Zephyr: firmware build epoch floor
description: Firmware build epoch as time floor. AC: Rejects time values before firmware build timestamp.
notes: Implemented immutable, mutex-protected Zephyr firmware build-epoch metadata initialization. time_sync_init consumes CONFIG_LICHEN_TIME_BUILD_EPOCH_UNIX plus provenance source; snapshots distinguish deterministic production release/SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from developer-generated/fixed/test metadata. Invalid source, zero/uint32 overflow, changed/replayed metadata, and below-floor samples fail before wall-clock mutation; identical retries are idempotent. Added standalone canonical packets-timing floor vectors, rollback/overflow/no-false-promotion/concurrent-init tests, and qemu regressions. Green: standalone UBSan 1/1; strict C11; clang analyzer; TSAN; qemu_cortex_m3 7/7; Python build/time-provider 21; Rust canonical time-provider vector 1 and lichen-link no_std clippy. Full module west configure is independently blocked by current LICHEN_COAP_KEYS<->ZCBOR Kconfig dependency loop; isolated direct qemu compilation/run of exact source is green. Full Python packets-timing has unrelated dirty SCHC ImportError (SchcSessionManager missing), while focused provider and Rust shared-vector parity are green.
